items.title: Ukraine: Civilian casualty rates among ‘deadliest’ in years, as energy attacks intensify
items.summary: Civilian casualties in Ukraine remain at record levels, with intensified Russian attacks in September continuing a pattern of harm in 2026 far exceeding previous years, UN human rights monitors in Ukraine said on Friday.

items.title: Ukraine: Civilian casualties hit highest level since March 2022
items.summary: Civilian casualties in Ukraine reached their highest monthly level in July, with more people killed and injured than at any time since March 2022, the UN Human Rights Monitoring Mission in the country, HRMMU, said in an update on Thursday.
